pataca.definition: n the basic unit of money in Macao
pataca.translation: n. 澳元(葡萄牙在澳门使用的货币单位)

patache.definition:
n. A tender to a fleet, formerly used for conveying men,
   orders, or treasure.

patagia.translation: n. 翼膜( patagium的名词复数 ); 领片

patagium.definition:
n. In bats, an expansion of the integument uniting the fore
   limb with the body and extending between the elongated fingers to form
   the wing; in birds, the similar fold of integument uniting the fore
   limb with the body.
n. One of a pair of small vesicular organs situated at the
   bases of the anterior wings of lepidopterous insects. See Illust. of
   Butterfly.
patagium.translation:
n. 翼膜
[医] 翼状膜

patagonia.definition: n. region in southern South America between the Andes and the South Atlantic
patagonia.translation: n. 巴塔哥尼亚(南美一地区)

patagonian.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Patagonia.
n. A native of Patagonia.
patagonian.translation:
a. (南美)巴塔哥尼亚高原的, 巴塔哥尼亚人的
n. 巴塔哥尼亚人

patamar.definition:
n. A vessel resembling a grab, used in the coasting trade of
   Bombay and Ceylon.

pataphysics.translation: [复]n.[用作单](讽刺科学思想和科学著作的) 荒诞玄学

patavinity.definition:
n. The use of local or provincial words, as in the
   peculiar style or diction of Livy, the Roman historian; -- so called
   from Patavium, now Padua, the place of Livy's nativity.
